desc:
Step into the ring in a boxing game built to feel real.

Slip, block and counter. Throw jabs, hooks, uppercuts, overhands and body shots. Every punch has weight, a clean shot can drop anyone, and every knockout plays back in slow motion.

CAREER MODE: 16 fights from amateur to world champion, with four belts to win and prize gloves on the way.
RANKED: climb from Bronze to Champion.
THE GYM: walk into any of 12 rings and fight whoever is there. The two gold rings are ranked.
PLAY A FRIEND: call out a friend for a one-on-one.

Earn XP to build your fighter, open crates for new gloves, and chase the legendary gloves with their own punch trails.

Play with keyboard, controller or touch.
